# The Late Appointment

The clock on the wall read 6:47 PM when I realized I was the last patient of the day. The waiting room had emptied hours ago, and through the half-open door of the exam room, I could hear Vanessa humming to herself as she sterilized instruments.

"Sorry about the late slot," she said, walking back in with that easy smile that had been distracting me for the past three appointments. Her scrubs were a deep burgundy today, fitted in a way that made it hard to focus on dental hygiene. "Dr. Patel left already. It's just us."

*Just us.*

She settled onto the rolling stool and pulled it close, closer than usual, until her knee pressed against my thigh. The chair tilted back smoothly under her hand.

"Open wide for me."

I did, and she leaned over, her chest brushing my arm as she worked. Her perfume was something warm—vanilla and something darker underneath. I tried to keep my eyes on the ceiling tiles, counting them, doing anything to keep my body from betraying the way my pulse was racing.

"You're tense today," she murmured, setting down the scaler. Her fingers traced along my jaw, ostensibly checking for swelling. "Everything okay?"

"Just a long week," I managed.

"Mmm." She didn't move her hand away. Instead, her thumb brushed across my lower lip, slow and deliberate. "You know, I've been looking forward to this appointment all week."

I turned my head slightly to look at her, and the heat in her dark eyes made my breath catch. She'd unzipped the top of her scrubs—when had she done that?—revealing the lace edge of a black bra.

"Vanessa—"

"Tell me to stop," she whispered, leaning down until her lips hovered just above mine, "and I will."

I didn't tell her to stop.

She kissed me hard, one hand sliding behind my neck while the other traveled down my chest. The exam chair creaked as she swung her leg over and straddled me, her weight settling perfectly against me. I groaned into her mouth and her tongue slipped past my lips, tasting like mint and want.

"I've thought about this," she breathed against my throat, grinding down slowly. "Every time you come in here with that nervous little smile."

My hands found her hips, then slid up under her scrub top, pushing it off entirely. The black lace bra came next, unhooked with shaking fingers. Her breasts were full and soft, and she gasped when I took one nipple into my mouth.

"God—" She arched against me, her hand fumbling at my belt. "I want you. Right now."

She slid off me just long enough to shimmy out of her scrub pants, and the sight of her standing there in nothing but a tiny pair of matching black panties nearly undid me. I stood and she pulled me against her, kissing me deeply while her hand found me through my jeans.

"You've been hiding this from me," she purred, squeezing. "That's not very polite."

She dropped to her knees on the clinic floor, dragging my jeans and boxers down with her. The moment her warm mouth wrapped around me I had to grip the arm of the chair to stay upright. She looked up at me with those dark eyes, her cheeks hollowing as she took me deeper, one hand stroking what she couldn't fit.

"You're incredible," I gasped.

She pulled back, lips glistening. "I want you to lose control, okay? Don't hold back."

She took me back into her mouth with renewed enthusiasm, her tongue swirling, her hand working in perfect rhythm. I tangled my fingers in her dark hair, watching her, the sight almost as overwhelming as the sensation. She moaned around me, the vibration sending shocks up my spine.

"Vanessa, I'm—I'm close—"

She pulled back, stroking me fast, her tongue flicking at the tip. "On my face," she whispered. "I want to feel it."

That was all it took. I came hard, ribbons of heat painting her cheeks, her lips, her chin. She kept stroking me through it, her eyes closed in bliss, her tongue catching what it could. By the time I was spent, her face was a glistening mess and she looked utterly satisfied with herself.

She smiled up at me, breathless. "Same time next month?"

I could only nod, collapsing back into the dental chair as she rose gracefully to find a towel.

"Good," she said, glancing over her shoulder with a wicked grin. "Don't forget to floss."
